name: hcapp_uncancelDownDown
description: Clears the cancelled flag on a DownDown charge (IsCancelled = 0), restoring it to pending state. The operation is idempotent — calling it on an already-pending charge succeeds without error. Auth: GM (MismanagementRoles bit 0x02) or RA (0x08). New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event. Used as auth scope and as part of the UPDATE WHERE clause. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event the DownDown belongs to. Used as part of the UPDATE WHERE clause. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

parameters.name: downDownId
parameters.description: DownDown to restore to pending. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. If no DownDown matches downDownId + eventId + kennelId, returns errorCode 4041, errorType 3.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Compact error envelope returned on auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled errors: { success=0, errorCode, errorType }. Mutually exclusive with SuccessEnvelope rowset.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on successful uncancel: { success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL }. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope rowset.
Returned (at index 1) alongside the ErrorEnvelope (index 0) on any auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled error.

sideEffects: Updates HC.DownDowns: sets IsCancelled = 0, UpdatedAt = GETUTCDATE() where id + eventId + kennelId match.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled errors.

codeSmells.issue: IsCancelled column is BIT in the table, not SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: HC.DownDowns.IsCancelled is declared as BIT NOT NULL. The project standard is SMALLINT. SQL Server implicitly converts the integer literal 0 used in the UPDATE. Dart callers must handle this as a JSON boolean, not an integer.

codeSmells.issue: No TRY/CATCH wrapping the UPDATE statement
codeSmells.detail: The main UPDATE is not inside a BEGIN TRY block. An unexpected DB error will propagate as a raw SQL error. XACT_ABORT ON ensures rollback, but the caller receives an unstructured error.
